The magic packet and DNS queries always use Wi-Fi outside the VPN; target names are resolved by this Wi-Fi network’s DNS. A sent packet does not prove a wake-up. The wake check then repeatedly tries the chosen port or ping: “no response” does not mean the device is off, and “already up” does not prove it was woken.
